newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 12.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Feb. 12:

WASHINGTON - Somewhere between his meeting with President Clinton and congressional Republicans and his appearance before the House Ways and Means Committee, Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin appeared to have wandered off "common ground."

WASHINGTON - A substantial part of the surge in economic growth in the final three months of last year was generated by gains in work efficiency that reduced inflation pressures, the Labor Department reported.
WASHINGTON - The American Institute of Certified Public Accountants has set out to change the public perception of the profession with a $3.5 million advertising campaign.

WILMINGTON, Del. - A Delaware judge heard arguments from lawyers representing Haft family members and their retail holding company, Dart Group Corp., and his decision could resolve the long-running battle over control of Dart.
